svg.aria-label: Teach Luca once: it asks, you answer, you confirm with one yes, it learns, and history is kept
svg.title: Teach Luca once: it asks, you answer, you confirm with one yes, it learns, and history is kept
svg.text: Tell Luca once. It remembers for every transfer after.

text.tspan: about a transfer it can't place, once, in the morning message.
in your own words, or by number: “1 was revenue”.
Luca lists exactly what will change. Nothing moves before “yes”.
that address is labeled the same way, before and after.
the old label stays on record, with your words and the rule it taught.
